label.en: A new launch date contradicts the remembered one
label.ms: Tarikh pelancaran baharu bercanggah dengan yang diingati

text:
Aina: Change of plan, the product launch is now on the 12th of December because the hall fell through.
Faris: Understood.

meetings.text:
Aina: We decided the product launch is on the 5th of December.
Faris: Good, I'll book the hall.

decisions.text: The product launch is on 5 December
decisions.quote: the product launch is on the 5th of December
